description_en: Queries the information of all created projects
description_zh: 调用ListProjects接口列出已创建的所有项目信息
name: ListProjects

parameters.help_en: The marker from which to return the list of projects in lexicographical order. If this parameter is not specified, projects are returned from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 从Marker开始按字典序返回项目信息列表。如果不设置此参数，则从头开始返回项目
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of projects to return. Default value: 100. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 返回项目的最大个数，默认值为100，取值范围为1~100
parameters.name: max_keys

NextMarker.description_en: The marker used to return the remaining projects in the next query. This parameter has a value only when not all projects are returned
NextMarker.description_zh:
下一次列出项目信息时以此值为Marker，将未返回的结果返回。 

当项目未全部返回时，此参数才有值

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the project

Endpoint.description_en: The endpoint of the region where the project resides
Endpoint.description_zh: 项目所在地域的服务地址

ModifyTime.description_en: The update time of the project. If the project has not been updated after creation, the update time is the same as the creation time
ModifyTime.description_zh:
项目的修改时间。

创建项目后，如果未更新过项目，则项目的修改时间和项目的创建时间相同

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the project resides

ServiceRole.description_en: The service role. If this parameter is not specified when the project is created, an empty value is returned
ServiceRole.description_zh:
服务角色。

如果创建项目时未指定此参数，则返回值为空
